scope: Bounded actual0.9.1 source and exact1.2 migrations inspection; no database/container mutations or model requests.

findings.result: Migration runner is gated by _run_migrations. Config HINDSIGHT_API_RUN_MIGRATIONS_ON_STARTUP=false parsed config.py3763 and passed server.py58/main.py268. False bypasses migration traversal of unknown new revision; inspect actual rollback config/startup and confirm no other provisioning path invoked.
Only runtime nonmigration reference to dropped memory_units_bm25 is admin restore REFRESH. Ordinary engine SQL need not have the matview; admin restore is not a rollback path and must not be used.

Dropped global indexes are stated redundant to bank partial indexes, not columns. Verify actual old query/index plan and latency on retained banks and newly created bank after upgrade. Do not recreate global indexes merely to satisfy schema equality.

Migration clears nonv2 structured JSON while preserving markdown. Old reader requires version1 but refresh catches v2 validation failure and parses stored markdown. Existing get/read can be compatible; old refresh can regenerate lossyv1. Test freshly produced v2 model content with nested lists/quotes/code and the actually used Eva style-model read+refresh; do not assume lossless future refresh for arbitrary rich markdown.

Migration changes unknown placeholder event_dates to NULL, not genuine finite source dates. Old temporal-link path explicitly skips None. Verify actual affected-row count/hashes and old recall/date rendering and new retain against such a bank; no need reconstruct invalid placeholders.

Worker initialization still happens with migration disabled. Old poller claims pending and recovers processing work, not just HTTP reads. Newer pending task payloads must be completed/drained before rollback or demonstrated parsable/behavior-equivalent by old worker; preserve cancelled/superseded/new operation metadata and never revive it implicitly.

mustTestOnSamePostWriteDatabase: Old exact baseline image start with migration disabled, exact extensions/vector dimension/settings/weights retained; complete engine initialization, background scheduler and taskbackend readiness, not only process HTTPhealth.

Fresh candidate retain selected/notselected, correction and idempotent sameoperation replay; restart candidate then old image on same database. Old GET reads exact new receipts and source hashes, old recall returns latest permitted fact, old replay issues no duplicate extraction.

Old retain a NEW bounded synthetic revision into existing migrated bank and separately a newbank; ensure missing global index/view does not break writes or vectors/keyword recall or unreasonable latency.

Candidate mentalmodelv2 read and actual Eva style refresh under old engine preserve content/authority; rich markdown compatibility limitation explicitly measured. Preserve disabled unmanaged schedules.
Candidate erase with derived/cache/tombstone state persists across old startup, recall and pending-work recovery. No old snapshot restore, no tombstone/erasure-generation rewind.

No mixed old/new writers. Before switch all native pending/processing/consolidation work settled or exact compatible payload replay proven; unknown child/parent remains unknown. Prove no resurrection from failed/cancelled/superseded historical payloads.

After old operation, switch forward to candidate with migration configuration controlled; latest data/receipts/erasure remain valid and native head unchanged. Schema Alembic head remains candidate head while old engine temporarily reads/writes with migrations disabled.
conclusion: Irreversible migration does not itself prove runtime backward incompatibility. Source makes a data-preserving oldimage rollback plausible without reverseDDL; only actual clone roundtrip establishes it. No blanket block or rollback-success claim from inspection.
